verdict.rationale: Chargebee documents official MCP servers that let Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other MCP clients access billing capabilities directly. It also supports custom MCP servers that expose subscription and invoice tools, for example an invoice lookup server, plus in-app AI that answers questions. Behind these sits a full REST API and SDKs, so an agent can query customer, subscription and invoice state directly. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the agent tools cover MRR/revenue metrics, delinquent-account and upcoming-renewal queries, and any independent hands-on corroboration of agent querying.
